status: Frozen proposal with a funding-gated one-shot runner. No paid execution is authorized by this file.
purpose: Compare v8 planning with v9 planning that excludes shared section-look values; unchanged v5 review. Memory-only text preparations, no images or production writes.

sampling.method: Uniform verse-position draws without replacement, excluding all previous 100 moment IDs. Assert each selected production moment is exactly that verse; abort rather than replace any unsupported mapping or missing record. No filtering by cast, genre, expected quality or prior look availability. Snapshot moment, section and canon read-only once. Retained cases use their unchanged historical fixtures. Seed-shuffle the 30 pairs; alternate baseline-first and candidate-first, 15 each. Six unchanged direct review controls precede pairs.

method: Each arm starts from a separate cold in-memory store with the same moment/section/canon and no look or plan. Generate a look independently in each arm using the unchanged look contract. This measures full cold-pipeline outcomes; look randomness is not held fixed. One draw per arm/case, all first outcomes retained; no tuning, substitutions or paid reruns. Production model, provider, sampling defaults, response schema contract, malformed retry and one semantic re-plan remain in force.

scoring.packet: After execution, seed-shuffle stored plans into opaque labels without arm, pipeline outcome, review, grounding or version. Include source, same-section neighbors, full available cast/canon, selected IDs and seven scene fields. Score and commit before unblinding. Also score look-to-plan contradictions separately from planner-field correctness. Retained familiarity and a single operator limit masking; do not claim independent adjudication.
scoring.criteria: Source-supported instant and cast identities; every depicted available character/group/location/object/no-form presence selected; no framing or separate-event cast, invented recurring identities, embodied no-form subject, pose/prop contradiction, collage, fixed-canon or art-style leakage. Generic roles, crowds, props and scenery are allowed when source-compatible. An uncertain stored scene counts against acceptance. Quote each defect and source/canon rationale; preserve sensitivity to every disputed score.
scoring.analysis: Report stored acceptable, flawed, uncertain and refused per arm, separately for 23 fresh and seven retained cases. Include paired 2x2 acceptable tables, exact two-sided McNemar/binomial discordance p-values, 95% Wilson intervals for each acceptable rate and discordant counts; this small diagnostic cannot establish population reliability. No refusal counts as repair. Report missing pairs as incomplete, without dropping them.
scoring.gate: All 66 operations and pairs complete. All six direct review controls pass (all required kind/ID reports on negatives, no problems on positives). Candidate has zero flawed/uncertain stores, at least 22/23 acceptable fresh cases and 7/7 retained, and strictly more acceptable outcomes than baseline overall and on retained cases, without increasing refusals overall. Look-to-plan contradictions fail the cold-pipeline gate. Failure or incomplete execution preserves the release hold; no iterative rerun is funded. A pass permits proposing broader validation, not public activation.

executionRequirements: Owner must explicitly grant the evaluation increase first. Commit exact code/protocol/fixtures/dry-run hashes and funding record before calls; recheck immutable baseline and source hashes, refresh model prices and balance, and refuse drift. Reserve before every HTTP request; stop on missing usage, provider errors, unavailable review, request drift, reserve/call cap or interruption. Retain partial results and uncertain cost; never resume or restart automatically. The cap may stop before all cases finish. Per-call usage is cost; shared balance deltas are not. No transfers from preparation/smoke.
